description: What to do if you or a loved one is being held by the police.

steps.text: Note the exact date and time the detention started.
Remember: you must be brought before a court within a reasonable time - one day if a court is within 40km, otherwise two days (s.35(5)).
Ask to be charged before a court, and ask your lawyer to apply for bail.
Do not pay for bail at the police station; bail from the police should not be sold.
Contact a lawyer or the Legal Aid Council if you cannot afford one.
If held unlawfully, you may be entitled to compensation and a public apology (s.35(6)).
